sentences.text: A UCB shall ensure there is no capitalisation of penal charges, meaning no further interest is computed on such charges.
A UCB may charge interest on unpaid interest, including unpaid EMI, at the contracted rate of interest till remediation, and not at the penal rate of interest.
A UCB must levy penalty for default only in the form of penal charges and not penal interest, and it shall not levy additional or fresh penal charges on earlier outstanding penal charges.
